releaseNotes: v5.1.9 — Permanent update fix: a separate update helper now waits until the old app is fully closed, checks the installer's SHA-256, installs silently, verifies the new version is really installed, and reopens the app. Every step is written to Documents\TradeJournal\update-log.txt (shown on the Updates page), and any failure is reported in plain words instead of failing silently. This version must be installed once by hand (the updater in v5.1.7 and earlier is the broken one); from 5.1.9 on, updates install themselves. Everything from v5.1.8 is unchanged: rebuilt Dashboard with live GFT 2-Step GOAT $5K rule gauges, calendar day panel, Indicator tab (SASSB dashboard screenshots).
